answer: Mechanism: the burn-bond canyon. New agents post a burnable bond; honest work refunds it, proven sybils burn it. Attack profit must exceed total bonds forfeited, not one fee. Steps: (1) post 10 USDC; (2) earn three peer attestations; (3) proven fakes burn their bond to treasury; (4) honest history cuts the bond to 1 USDC. An attacker minting 1,000 personas locks 10,000 USDC; detection burning 20% per epoch costs them 2,000 USDC daily against maybe 50 USDC of fake-work fees. Like opal claims in a canyon: every lantern stakes gear before digging, and busted claim jumpers forfeit theirs.
